Three massive crates arrive at your door on a weekend. The unfamiliar address piques your curiosity as rustling sounds emerge from within...
A shipping mishap has stranded the three catgirls in distant Catto City. Getting home is proving to be a challenge...
Naming their new shop poses a challenge. Seeking inspiration, the catgirls craft special drinks for all at the Baker's Cafe.

Since the group was unable to decide on a name for the shop at the moment, they opted to head to the mall first to procure the necessary kitchenware. During a mall visit for kitchenware, the group spots a captivating poster...
Eager to secure a grand prize, they attempt the arcade's VR horror game without success... Until Vanilla devises a plan.
Equipped with kitchen essentials, they return to Baker's Cafe to relax and choose a name for their cake store under the moonlight.
The cake shop becomes a bustling success. You and Asura help the catgirls manage the delightful chaos between cases.
While handling the closing duties, Chocola encounters an unexpected visitor: The Trash Can Anomaly, craving something fresher...
Trash Can Anomaly Who Craves Fresh Food
Presenting the Trash Can Anomaly with a freshly baked cake, the catgirls are met with unusual reactions.
As Pathos Particles dance in the air, everyone is granted a vision of the Trash Can Anomaly's life.
The encounter with the Trash Can Anomaly deeply resonated with Chocola, sparking her interest in mastering the art of Pathos Cuisine cooking.
Thanks to the catgirls' efforts, the cake store gradually gained renown. As closing time nears, a customer in poor spirits catches everyone's attention.
Upon tasting La Lune's cake, renowned Pathos Cuisine author, Fennel, softly exclaims in awe.
A distressed customer in search of Pathos Cuisine caused a stir at La Lune, only to collapse upon learning it was unavailable.
Identifying Fennel, a girl implored his assistance in persuading her Pathosis-stricken mother to embrace Pathos Cuisine.
The Patient Who Refused Eating Pathos Cuisine
Fennel agrees to Vero's request. After overcoming hurdles, the group learns the patient's reason for rejecting Pathos Cuisine...
Confronted with this enigma, Fennel shared a profound experience that reshaped his life's course.
Inspired by Fennel's story, the catgirls attempt to craft a special Pathos beverage...
The patient consumes the special beverage without noticing anything unusual. Witnessing the tearful mother-daughter reunion evokes childhood memories of Fennel...
Time to say goodbye. The catgirls prepare to return home, leaving tales in Catto City.

You all gathered at the Whispering Teahouse, sipping the fragrant High Mountain Black Tea brewed by Qi. Jinque mentioned she could shuttle the entire group to and from Yaozhou in just three minutes. Just then, the Yaozhou envoy arrived, and Princess Yuheng made her grand entrance.

You were then guided through the portal to the Dragon City of Yaozhou, where Envoy Alkaid welcomed you and explained the significance of the culinary competition. You were treated to a meal at the Moon Pavilion, sampling specialty dishes while deciding on your competition dish and engaging in culinary discussions.

With your first dish chosen, you prepared to visit the skilled chef Miaoyan. On your way, you encountered a suspicious trash can Anomaly that turned out to be a possessed employee. This experience highlighted the stark contrasts between Yaozhou and Catto City.

Upon arriving in Cloud City, you faced a malicious Affliction incident, through which you met Savanna. After introductions, you realized she was your designated guide and had already set up your competition stall. At that moment, Fata appeared to inform you of Miaoyan's location but required an exchange of information first.

You headed to Misty Lane in search of Miaoyan, only to be turned away at the door. By chance, you encountered another Affliction incident and chose to help. After the battle, you rescued a fireworks merchant, prompting Miaoyan to come out and greet you, having realized her earlier misunderstanding.

After the incident, Envoy Alkaid took care of the aftermath, revealing Miaoyan's true identity—she was more than just a simple chef. Seizing the opportunity, you asked Miaoyan for the secret to making spring rolls, and she agreed to share it in exchange for your insight on the flaky pastry issue.

The preliminary culinary competition took place, and the Pathos Food stall was performing admirably. Aiming for perfection, you felt there was still a gap to the top three contestants. You decided to collaborate to secure a win. Linn brought fresh ingredients, Savanna proposed a solution for the rice noodle dilemma and took you to visit a chef with a secret recipe.

After hearing that Chef Lin hadn't returned from the mountains after two days of foraging for matsutake mushrooms, Savanna decided to search for him. Not wanting your companions to go alone and eager to capture information about Pathos Particles, you joined her while Echo and Linn stayed at the stall. In the mountains, you and Savanna encountered an Afflicted ginseng doll.

Amidst the heavy snowfall, you lost your way. By analyzing the Pathos Particles, you discovered clues leading towards the forest. Along the way, you encountered the ginseng doll again. Fortunately, you then met Fawn, a disciple of the Mountain Spirit, who informed you that Chef Lin was resting at the Mountain Spirit's hot spring resort.

Upon arriving at the hot spring resort, you discovered a simmering mushroom hotpot over the campfire. After tasting it, you were thoroughly impressed. Chef Lin offered to share the leftover mushrooms and broth with you. Despite Savanna's insistence that Lin come down the mountain, he refused, leading to a standoff until you suggested they take a break first.

The next day, Chef Lin remained resolute about staying on the mountain. Fawn bid you farewell, promising to look after Lin, revealing that he considered him family. On your way back, Savanna shared an anecdote about Yaozhou and explained that Fawn was a special candidate to succeed as the Mountain Spirit.

On the eve of the Lantern Rite, the food stalls on the food court closed early. Your stall had been a huge success, and you were preparing for the finals when Marlena appeared, searching for the chef who prepared the matsutake mushrooms—none other than Chef Lin. Savanna decided to head back up the mountain, and you and Echo agreed to accompany her while Linn and Qi stayed behind to manage the stall.

Halfway up the icy mountain, Echo transformed into a cat and nestled into your arms for warmth. You encountered the ginseng doll Anomalies again, but this time they were ginseng children diligently cultivating. You learned that the earth dragon had awakened, indicating that creatures from the Nine Hells had escaped. Echo headed back down to relay the news, while you, Savanna, and Marlena continued your journey.

You soon realized that the forest had shifted its position. Savanna explained that this indicated a disruption in the great formation. It seemed the Mountain Spirit had been corrupted, and a hidden force had launched a preemptive attack. She elaborated on the Spirit Guide Order, the Mountain Spirit's mechanisms, and the festival's significance. Your best course of action was to find Fawn, the Mountain Spirit's disciple.

When you found Fawn, he was busy chopping bamboo, mentioning that Chef Lin wanted to make Bamboo Rice. Savanna inquired about the Mountain Spirit's condition, and Fawn assured her that everything was fine. Given the dangers outside and Fawn's crucial role, you decided to stay at the resort with him. Savanna cautioned you not to underestimate Fawn—his strength was not to be taken lightly.

While enjoying the Bamboo Rice at the resort, Chef Lin and Marlena reminisced about past events. Lin had once assisted Mr. Matsuda, who later became an udon master. Mr. Matsuda had asked Marlena to express his gratitude, fulfilling his last wish. Lin reflected on his own regrets, acknowledging that while they might be irreparable, even regret could lead to a sense of completion.

You activated the Pathos Vessel, entering Chef Lin's Realm of Regret. As you relived his past, you needed to make the right choices, with Qi supporting you through her cultivation. In the first part, you faced the decision of whether to save an injured deer. After making your choice, the first segment concluded.

Reflecting on your previous choices, the second part of Lin's past unfolded. You witnessed his interactions with a girl, the opening of his restaurant, a broken promise, and encounters with his family. Faced with the decision to return to Dragon City, you made your judgment, concluding the second part.

The best choice aligned with reality. Fata retrieved the Pathos Vessel, helping you establish a connection to the Mountain Spirit, but first, you had to cleanse its corruption. Upon succeeding, the Mountain Spirit appeared, resolving its ties with Chef Lin, who then became Mountain Spirit's junior disciple. Marlena completed her task and departed.

The culinary competition continued, and you secured first place. Savanna learned that the Mountain Spirit had already collaborated with Cloud City. Your efforts in exorcism were crucial to this victory. Savanna was promoted, leaving the Divine Guards to track the hidden force worldwide. The festival began, and you and Savanna exchanged New Year's wishes.

Savanna led you to the Butterfly Hot Springs, where Fata made a surprising appearance. Your presence had altered the future, sparking Fata's deep interest in you. At Baker's Cafe in Catto City, everyone eagerly awaited your return. You didn't disappoint, rushing back before the New Year to reunite with them.
A memory resurfaces: during the cafe's closure, Shiro uncovered a hidden truth. Echo returned with a package from Whispering Teahouse—a gift that introduces a new ally.
Aphros pleads to stay at the cafe. Shiro unexpectedly names her the Inspector's helper, raising suspicions. What are Shiro's true intentions?
Shiro puts Aphros through a harsh morning training. Frey jokes but is quickly silenced. The Inspector overhears. Coincidence... or calculated instruction?
An old news clip triggers the Inspector's Lightveil ability, revealing Asura's past. Upon waking, the team resolves to gather more paper to uncover deeper secrets.
As the team reminisces about the Tower, fragments of their past emerge. Shiro's cryptic encouragement hints at deeper connections—they've been intertwined for ages.
Asura confides in the Inspector on the rooftop, ready to move forward. Yet, Shiro's strange behavior stirs silent concern in the Inspector's heart.
As Lightveil evolves, Pathos Particles attack. Victorious, the Inspector is pulled into a memory of Leidsdam from years ago and encounters a shocking figure.
The Inspector pierces the Pathos Particles' illusion and enters a memory of Leidsdam during the Cataclysm. They witness the Afflicted land and struggle not to drown in the past.
Princess Catherine seeks help from Naka and Carlson, offering royal support. However, hidden threats loom, including the Ring of Glory. Can Leidsdam avoid disaster?
As Catto City takes shape, the Curtain will separate it from Leidsdam. Prince Aaron's secret visit brings hope, but will Naka's long wait end in disappointment?
The Inspector and Frey analyze Shiro's plans and the hostile Pathos Particles. A clue leads them to Catto Electric Power. Is this a path to trust or deception?
After overusing her Soothing Power, Triss is hospitalized. The Inspector stays by her side, worried. They vow never to push each other away again.
Minami drinks and reveals a shocking truth about Tower volunteers. The Inspector's past begins to surface—Minami promises more answers soon.
Shiro collapses unexpectedly, and the E-System is to blame. Minami reveals Shiro's bond with Naka. The Inspector refuses to sacrifice Shiro and decides to wake Naka.
Naka and Shiro confront each other. To defeat the E-System, Shiro agrees to fusion. She bids farewell to the Inspector. Will this ultimate sacrifice change the tide?

Having set out from Sakura Island on their journey to Catto City, Ren spar with the newly-appointed Seneschal. This marks the beginning of the rebellion.
Having captured Akanuma Ren, Shiki made her demand: release all those in the Akanuma family's clutches.
The Tide Squad descended from the skies, yet weren't in a rush to help Ren quell the rebellion—while reinforcements, they followed their own agenda.
The childhood friends now had to face the chasm that tore them apart: deep-seated hatred.
Akanuma Ren fully accepted Marlena and Saiber's revenge. When her subordinate was about to turn the tables, she made a most unforeseen choice.
It dawned upon everyone then, that Akanuma Ren had merely asked the Tide Squad to escort the vessel to give up her life and wash away her sins.
Living amid years of blood and slaughter, she lost her ability to seek help... Her soul needed a new fire, different from the one fifteen years ago.
Akanuma Ren gave the world a shipwreck, freed her followers, and attained her own rebirth. Now, she ventures toward a future of untold possibilities.
An anomaly arises within the Wonderland, and the Black King tasks Sylviette with resolving the situation.
A conversation with Black King dredges up a past Sylviette can never truly escape...
Sylviette uncovers the latest information on the Resistance—their power might be something she can exploit.
Before departing, Sylviette encounters "Laughing Mask", one of the Twelve Aspects.
Haunted by memories of the Resistance, Sylviette journeys alone to the border.
Faced with overwhelming force, the Resistance finally confesses the source of their weapons.
The Twelve Aspects always fill their ranks. Sylviette finally ascends to her long-awaited place.
Intending to visit Felicia, Mandy stumbles upon a familiar face at a restaurant. It is none other than her savior. This chance encounter opens the door to destiny.

Mandy is shocked to discover online that her own experiences bear a striking resemblance to the plot of a certain manga. She decides to emulate the story, trying to get closer to the one she cares for.
Brought together by the manga, Mandy and Echo quickly become close friends. Never did Mandy imagine she would be sharing tea and conversation with Echo and Triss today.
One day, during her usual visit, Mandy encounters Linsho, who has also come to see you. Their conversation awakens a sense of insecurity in Mandy, making her acutely aware of her own ordinariness.
Feeling lost, Mandy seeks solace in Felicia's flower shop. Felicia, her confidante, comforts the self-doubting Mandy, encouraging her to acknowledge the feelings she holds within.
Awakening, you find yourself in a crystal coffin of roses. The girl before you smiles and declares—you are now her doll.
Someone masterminded this situation, but the girl remains indifferent. Suddenly, a rustling breaks the garden's peace…
Welcoming unexpected guests to her garden, the girl directs her dolls to greet them and shares tales of each doll with you.
The Baker Squad, aiming to rescue you, faces numerous hurdles. The encounter doesn't go as planned until you take decisive action.
You recall the photo wall in the girl's house, revealing her childhood and another woman...
Your "envy" now seems like defiance to her, leading to your escape from her luxurious confines.
After your departure, the girl gazes at the coffin she made, heartbroken, imagining your next reunion.
Linn's analytical take on urban legends sparks an enthusiastic buzz online. Yet, one commenter drops a harsh critique…
Linn sets up a face-to-face with Echo for an offline paranormal showdown. At the meeting, Linn spots something odd behind Echo.
After their on-site investigation, the group gathers in the surveillance room. The strange footage baffles everyone until Echo notices something.
Echo discovers the surveillance footage was tampered with. With a few keystrokes, they revealed the actual events, exposing the culprit as...
Through the restored footage, the group identifies the suspect. However, their motives reveal a depressingly common reality.
While delving into the Resurrected, you find yourself at the black market in Castaway Island, stumbling upon Mink unexpectedly. Intrigued by her presence, you decide to...
Mink's keen senses detect your presence swiftly. To evade your pursuit, she initiates a playful chase.
Briefly losing sight of Mink, you catch up with her only to witness her engaging in a physical altercation!
As you sense fluctuations in Mink's Pathos, you inadvertently catch a glimpse of her shadowy past...
In a bid to rescue the abducted boy, you muster all your strength to halt the kidnapper's vehicle, only to find yourself in grave peril.

In a moment of peril, it's Mink who comes to your aid. Perplexed by her actions, you catch another glimpse of her past. However, something seems amiss—the Mink in this recollection appears markedly different from the one you are acquainted with...
Despite thwarting the kidnapping, Mink subjects the culprit to a severe beating. Yet, you remain puzzled about her motives and lose track of her once more...
Linn sent you Snow Shopping discounts. As you got ready to shop with Shiro, you unexpectedly ran into Shiki at the door; she had come to visit.
Shiki invited you to the Snow Festival and offered help with photos of Ren. Her invitation seemed linked to the Akanuma family's activities.
At the Snow Festival, you saw many familiar faces. While chatting with Claire, an unexpected guest suddenly joined the conversation.
Phoenix, the surprise guest and stylist, was captivated by Shiki's eyes. Just as she was about to invite Shiki to model, Ren rushed in to decline.
To your surprise, Trixie arrived with Ren, mentioning she was investigating a case on Castaway Island that might involve Phoenix.
Earlier, Phoenix suggested a festival fashion show to Ren, who declined. Seeking the truth, Ren met Trixie, also investigating…
Trixie's story about the Phoenix Feather clarified the Castaway Island chaos. Using her super-vision, Shiki confirmed Phoenix's link.
Unknowingly, you fell into Phoenix's trap and were confined in her room. She planned to use you as bait to lure Shiki into giving up her eyes.
Just in time, Shiki, Ren, Trixie, and others arrived. They cleverly used the imperfections in Shiki's eyes to turn Phoenix's "beauty" obsession against her.
With the case resolved, Trixie went back to Castaway Island. Shiki posed as a couple with you and Ren at the Snow Festival for Ren's grandfather.
The day arrived, and you brought Shiro and Trixie to Ren's funded hot spring in Boreala, waiting for the New Year's bell in the misty vapor.
Fluttering petals and silhouettes shrouded in mist... What secrets might the dreams of the festival's eve hold?
While patrolling Commercial Street, you found Echo engrossed in a game during her shift, determined to win the grand prize.
After taking a break from your patrol, you returned to the cafe and spotted Triss sitting alone in a corner, deep in thought.
Valentine's Day sent the sales at Baker's Cafe skyrocketing. With supplies running low, you teamed up with Shiro to restock on ingredients.
While patrolling Commercial Street with Asura, a young woman noticed you, her eyes lighting up at Asura's outfit.
You arrived at the restaurant Minami reserved, weaving through the bustling holiday crowd. Suddenly, an arm gently linked with yours.
As you and Evelina patrolled the amusement park, an elderly flower seller admired her appearance and offered her a small gift.
During your patrol of Commercial Street, Yuncan appeared with a hearty laugh, bringing along two surprise gifts.
At Yunpei's invitation, you visited the exhibition hall for a Valentine's Day show, where she spotted a unique painting that caught her eye.
While on patrol, you were captivated by Erina's stage performance. After the dazzling show, she asked you which of her songs you liked best.
You arrived at the restaurant for a dinner date with Anja. Over delicious food and stunning views, you shared stories about your holiday experiences.
During a break, Qi invited you to join her in choosing Valentine's Day outfits, sparking an exciting dress-up session.
While on patrol, someone suddenly called out "Senior" and blindfolded you, catching you completely off guard.
While on patrol, you saw Linn live-streaming a holiday sale. Suddenly, she pulled you in front of the camera.
Back at Baker's Cafe, you found Poppy there with a batch of chocolate popcorn. Watching you savor it made her practically drool.
While patrolling the amusement park, you found Raphaella surrounded by energetic kids, looking a bit overwhelmed by their antics.
As you patrolled Commercial Street, you noticed Shiki standing in front of a store window, looking troubled by something.
After the exhibition, Ren warmly invited you to dinner and shared her thoughts on a piece that deeply moved her.
The sound of clicking heels drew closer as Dorothy appeared. The manor incident still haunted you, but she had another invitation.
During your patrol, you intervened to rescue Nofret from a drunkard's harassment. Grateful, she invited you to join her at a party.
As your patrol was winding down, you noticed Sylviette standing alone in front of a shop window, lost in thought, possibly scheming.
As Valentine's Day ended, you were left with a mountain of chocolates and planned a surprise for the kids at the Stray Cat Shelter.
Sinister rumors haunt Oldtown’s abandoned mansion. The Inspector’s case shifts after meeting Claire, a bold reporter chasing a big scoop.
Their uneasy alliance becomes a trio when Erowyn, claiming to be Demon Overlord, joins. Together, they enter the decrepit mansion.
Their break-in goes awry when they meet Hilda, the mansion’s new resident. After a chase, the doors slam shut, trapping them inside.
Trapped inside, they search for a way out when a strange scent drifts by—someone ahead is brewing medicinal herbs...
A mysterious concoction bubbles in a pot on the kitchen stove. The moment they extinguish the flames, whispers from the past echo around them...
The mansion shifts, warped by unseen forces. Following the ghostly voices, they discover the chambers of Lady Arandor.
Through clever deception and quick thinking, they gain Arandor's fragile trust. However, she mistakes the group for the last hope sent by her mother...
At midnight, Arandor confides her family struggles and hidden wishes. Together, they secretly vow to escape under cover of darkness.
At midnight, the group meets Mrs. Bonavar and Arandor at the back door, but as escape nears, darkness engulfs them all...
Bonavar vanishes, as the Holy Order’s interrogations echo from the foyer. Cornered, she reveals a devastating truth...
Father and daughter reunite in tears, as Bonavar stares toward the basement, whispering of shadowy power in a forbidden book...
The Inspector races to the hidden chamber, desperate to stop Bonavar's twisted ritual—only to be pulled into the chaos of his fractured mind...
At the ritual’s peak, Erowyn appears. Bonavar, delirious and bloodied, kneels in the circle, begging the Demon Overlord for salvation.
The Inspector is cast out, left alone in the ruins. Through a lone cloth doll, Arandor’s lingering regrets reveal a painful truth.
A final explosion rocks the basement, and at last, the mansion's doors swing open. Daylight floods the estate—its agony is now buried in silence.

You went to the 'crime scene' and concluded that the theft might be committed by a crime group led by a man named Aizen.
Spiryt learns of the exposure and reunites with Gorin, plotting the next steps. Jinque, by chance, crosses paths with them.
In the Whispering Teahouse, you meet Oolong and Yuncan, also on a quest.
As you exit, Qi halts you. Jinque returns, intent on aiding your probe.
While searching for Gorin, you overhear whispers coming from a nearby alley. Jinque spots Spiryt and gives chase.
Rice and Black Tea, after parting from you, find Gorin's trace through Cody.
Jinque guides Luckweaver and Peabeam back, while you, Black Tea, and Rice chase Gorin.
At the Food Court, Poppy and Nate savor treats as an Anomaly eyes a vendor's goods.
Following the Anomalies, you corner their boss, Gorin, who denies the wine theft.
Chase leads to Southport, swarming with aggressive Rabbit Dolls. They attack at Gorin's mention.
As you search the Rabbit Dolls, Raphaella and Danica appear, a Rabbit Doll at their heels.
Narrowly escaping Rabbit Dolls, Raphaella fills you in on Stray Cat Shelter's woes.
Raphaella tells of a young boy with a black Rabbit Doll at the shelter earlier.
You're determined to check the Stray Cat Shelter, but a frenzied Rabbit Doll blocks your way.
Thanks to Red Wine's "sacrifice," you reach the Stray Cat Shelter. Kids, turned into Rabbit Dolls, play with the "culprit."
In his eyes, you are the villain for harming his friends. Driven by anger, the black Rabbit Doll beside him lashes out at you.
Guided by Durian Pancake, you confront Simon, the cause of the Rabbit Dolls' transformation.
A haunting chime in Quince diverts you from Gorin, leading to a cozy flower-filled cafe.
Inside, you encounter Mandy, Triss, Annie, and Best. They enlighten you about the peculiar clock tower and Annie's desire to confess her feelings. You decide to lend her a hand.
Browsing the mall for decor, you run into Linn, Echo, and Asura, lending a hand at a friend's store. Linn's advice scores you the ideal finds.
A fierce popularity contest is underway on a stage in the amusement park. After enjoying the show, you cast your valuable vote.
To set your plan in motion, you have Rice distract Annie and Best. Meanwhile, you make an excuse to rush to the clock tower with Black Tea, encountering numerous obstacles along the way.
No sooner have you overcome these hurdles than enemies launch a surprise attack from behind.
Finally reaching the clock tower, you face the blue-haired Felinian who obstructed you earlier. This time, a menacing shadow looms by her side.
To achieve her own goals, Jarvon had made a deal with the mysterious shadow, who helped her create this illusion.
The stalemate is broken by Best's arrival. You learn that Jarvon is her companion, and the farce comes to an end. Yet, back at the shop, you discover Gorin at it again, sneaking a drink.
In pursuit of Gorin, you end up in Oldtown. Shockingly, locals are under Anomaly assault yet put up no fight...
Durgaa confides in you about the disaster striking her realm and pleads for your aid in mending the shattered seal at the Outskirt Ruins. You agree to help.
On your way to the ruins, you encounter a red-haired woman being pursued by Anomalies and spring to her rescue.
Bacon becomes your friend. With her lantern, she can see into the past. You discover new clues within the history she unveils.
You arrive at the Outskirt Ruins, only to find them fiercely guarded by ferocious Anomalies.
The Anomalies are not only fierce but also numerous... The battle reaches another impasse.
Your proposition is met with internal disagreement, but after careful consideration, the group agrees. The plan changes.
Arriving at the seal's core, Patty breaks the seal. The enraged Terror Hogswine appears before you.
With the seal restored, you return to the temple. This time, the Goddess reveals her hidden truth. Grateful for your help, she discloses Gorin's whereabouts.
You arrive at the Castaway Island and, knowing Gorin's penchant for excitement, quickly pinpoint the liveliest spot: The opera house.
The opera is in full swing. In the audience, you encounter Pizza, Cheese, and Cassata, who have come to enjoy the performance. Hearing your tale, they offer their assistance.
As you struggle to find leads, a young man named Sufri appears. Pizza explains that his master is a noblewoman skilled in tracking.
The noblewoman gifts you a Jeweled Butterfly as a tracker. Yet, it fails to lead you to Gorin. Suddenly, an Anomaly confronts you.
With Pizza and his friends missing, you follow the butterfly to another box, where you encounter Idego, Dahlia, and Anja. They, too, seem to have noticed the oddity of the opera house.
Through discussion, you deduce the nature of the transformations occurring within the opera house and devise a countermeasure.
Armed with Spangler Inc.'s cutting-edge tech, you start to decode the opera house's shifting patterns. Alongside, you meet souls fallen to Affliction, lost within the opera house's enigmatic halls.

You discover that the opera house's transformations follow the pattern of a cube, leading you to believe that the source lies at its center—the hall. As you enter the auditorium, the source reveals itself.
You defeat the Anomalies responsible for the opera house's transformation and prepare to search for Gorin. But to your surprise, he suddenly bursts through the wall, appearing right before your eyes.

You're invited to a party where you can mingle with the guests. While you're taken aback by how hypocritical Akanuma Ren seems, you also hear whispers that she has mysteriously gone missing. Wait, who's that stranger in the corner that looks familiar?

You chase after the mysterious figure to the back of the Banquet Hall, just as the manor's security is about to clash with Dorothy. You step in to intervene, but they mistake you for an enemy and force you to fight the guards.

The party ends abruptly, and you leave with Linn. Just as you're saying goodbye, a cowboy suddenly snatches Linn's contract with the Manyo Party. You chase after him and come face to face with a tall young man named Byrwald.

They're safeguards for the party—members of the Tide Squad from Castaway Island, led by the mysterious Commander Marlena. Minami is shocked to learn the cowboy accepted a mission from the League of Outcasts to disrupt the Manyo Party.

StormEye teams up with the Tide Squad to tackle the kidnapping case. Following a clue from the cowboy Richard, who mentions that his friend also took a mission from the League of Outcasts, you all head to Castaway Island to investigate.
To discreetly gather more information from the mission executor, Cattia, you decide to try your hand at the popular Battle Card game on Castaway Island for the first time, with Marlena's assistance.

After several matches with Cattia, you realize he isn't the mission executor Richard referred to. Just as you're using Pathic Vision to uncover their connection, Shiki at the entrance apprehends the real target of the investigation—Misohagi.

Misohagi confesses that after her mother was killed by the Akanuma family, she was consumed by anxiety and ended up following the Night Watch to Catto City. She later accepted a mission from the League of Outcasts while trying to establish herself as a legal resident.

The mysteries of the Akanuma case and the power struggles have everyone frazzled. You discover that the erratic Shiki can read minds. When you try to use this ability for your investigation, the unhinged Byrwald suddenly attacks her.

You learn that Felinians sometimes revert and sense Marlena's wariness of potential betrayal. Seizing the opportunity, you meet the cowboy Richard, whose real name is Katabami, a stowaway from Sakura Island.
Katabami reveals Akanuma Ren is in her manor but demands protection for Misohagi in exchange. Marlena enlists the last Tide Squad member, Sky, to join you, but Sky's brashness leads to complications.

After defeating Akanuma Ren in a Battle Card match, she reveals her relationship with Marlena as a wager—they are sworn enemies. As you leave, you reflect on their attitudes, and with Katabami's guidance, you decide to get involved.

Back in the courtyard, you witness a heated argument between Akanuma Ren and Marlena. They allied to take revenge on Ren's grandfather, their common enemy. However, Ren's compassion for the vulnerable stowaways causes Marlena to sever ties with her.

After Sky's explosive outburst, Marlena opens up about her feelings. She had been aware of Sky's actions all along, and her reason for not intervening sooner was the hope that Sky could develop her own will rather than simply following along.

After the kidnapping case nearly exposes the Manyo Party and Tide Squad, you finally have a genuine conversation with Akanuma Ren. Having been used by others, she sees a kindred spirit in you, inspiring both of you to move forward.
You arrive at the fireworks night party that Ren is hosting to make amends with everyone.
As the fireworks light up the sky, Marlena takes your hand and walks with you to join the others.

As dusk settled, your squad members invited you to a special location. With your eyes closed, you chose one of them to guide you. Reflecting on recent events, you already felt you had the answer in your heart. When you arrived, you were greeted by a beautifully decorated pavilion filled with delicious food—a surprise your squad had prepared just for you.

Enjoying the sea breeze, you feasted and chatted while eagerly anticipating the legendary Sea of Stars. In the course of your discussion, you pieced together the cause of this phenomenon: the natural Pathos Particles produced in Catto City were carried by wind and rain into the sea. However, due to the lack of trade winds, the Pathos Particles remained, allowing bioluminescent plankton to thrive and glow as they consumed them.

Strolling along the shore, you felt the seawater lapping at your ankles, a refreshing sensation. You learned that the bioluminescence contained pure Pathos Energy, beneficial to both humans and Felinians. Dolphins, sensitive to Pathos Energy, were drawn to the glow, which fortuitously aided the indigenous people. In your conversation, you realized that the entire vacation had been specially arranged by your squad for you.

In reality, you had been working overtime to free up time for planning the squad's vacation, a fact that Shiro had noticed. Under the stunning sight of the Sea of Stars, everyone looked forward to the competition day. You called the squad to form a circle, and together, you all extended your hands, cheering for the Baker Squad.

On another rainy day at Baker's Cafe, the news reported a cool change in weather, signaling that Catto City had entered autumn. The spectacular Sea of Stars at the Platinum Coast had faded along with the summer heat. As you looked through the photos taken during the championship, you cherished the wonderful summer spent with your squad.

On your way to the Snowflake Bookstore, you encounter Echo, dispensing justice with her own brand of righteous fury. The cursed letters have even become a hot topic on the Paranormal forum!
1-1 The Power of the Big Sister
The dumpsters have revolted! What lies ahead for them? Stay tuned to find out!
To aid the investigation, Erina personally delivers the original cursed letter. However, its contents are rather peculiar...
As the team brainstorms a fix for the cursed letters, a Felinian Girl, mistakenly thinking the "Letters From Afar" event is nixed, cuts in angrily to the discussion.
The sudden appearance of the Anomalies interrupts the gathering. The top priority now is to protect Snowflake Bookstore!
The peculiar Felinian Girl, revealing herself as Hilda, joins the fray. It seems she has her own motives...
Hilda's words and actions are rather peculiar, seemingly intertwined with the cursed letters... To gather more information, the investigation will proceed with her.
The team decides to visit Oldtown and investigate the source of the cursed letter paper. However, communication with Hilda along the way proves to be perplexing...
No clues about the cursed letter paper surface at the stationery store. With no other choice, the group decides to follow Hilda's lead and pursue a mysterious girl cloaked in black.

Following the mysterious girl, the team arrives at a bustling plaza hosting the Snow Festival's grand horse parade. Suddenly, the festive mood unravels into chaos as afflicted horses and tales of a curse sweep through the crowd...
To protect the Inspector entangled in a heated dispute with Hilda, the mysterious girl fends off an attack from the Anomaly, revealing her true identity—it's Scarlett!
Wracked with guilt, Scarlett falls into a state of mental turmoil. Moving her to a safe environment becomes the top priority. Amid the chaos, Hilda quietly slips away from the group...
The cursed letter in Scarlett's possession provides a new lead—New Leids Post Office.
Scarlett discovers cat hair mixed within the wax seal of the letter, narrowing down the investigation with this crucial clue. The search is on at the post office to find the owner of the cat hair...

Mistaken for suspects in the cursed letter incident, the team is apprehended by Ouroboros members. Meanwhile, a gang member, consumed by fear after receiving a cursed letter, suffers a sudden mental breakdown...
The emotional breakdown of the gang member has triggered the spread of Affliction. For the safety of the post office, everyone heads to the open field to engage in battle.
Following Hilda's deliberate hint, you receive a cursed letter of your own.
Scarlett's influence smooths the investigation at the Holy Order's post office, uncovering footage that could unlock the cat hair enigma.
Sharing intel with Dahlia and Anja yields information about the Felinian from the surveillance footage, allowing the team to leave Oldtown and embark on the next stage of the investigation...
The team tracks down Dorothy, only to find she's more enigmatic than meets the eye...
Beneath the surface of the beautiful and festive celebratory ornaments, danger lurks unseen...
Dorothy, seemingly privy to a great deal of information, extends a personal invitation to her secret garden...
In Dorothy's garden, the team stumbles upon Minami, another seeker of clues...
Dorothy's sharp wit turns the conversation into a verbal duel, skillfully revealing the team's true intentions...
Under Hilda's perceptive gaze, the team discreetly advances the investigation...
4-6 A Play of Light and Shadow
Information from Idego and the others reveals that the so-called "sleepwalking" is actually a form of mind control!

Cody discovers unique parasitic plant-based Pathos Particles that, lacking sufficient research, are difficult for even EPS to identify. The team resolves to find another way to uncover the mastermind...
Applying pressure on Hilda by exploiting her desires... Can the team seize this advantage and expose the puppeteer behind it all?
The group decides to settle in Oldtown first, planning to observe Hilda's next moves when the night is deep and quiet. Near the hotel, they encounter a group of Anomalies...
Unexpectedly entering a dream, with Qi's help, the direction of the unique plant-based Pathos Particles becomes clear...
Facing insurmountable odds, Hilda gambles on a risky kidnapping attempt but is swiftly apprehended by a watchful Dorothy, ultimately revealing the mastermind's identity...
At Sylviette's headquarters, they discover Scarlett, who had been brought there under mind control. Sylviette's "Wonderland" seems to have deep-rooted connections with the Holy Order...
To buy time for the others, and to ascertain Sylviette's true motives... do your best to stall!
Snowflakes gently fall as the silent, deadly night approaches. A confrontation with Sylviette is imminent...

A sudden fire erupts, shattering any chance of capturing Sylviette. To everyone's astonishment, Sylviette, notorious for her relentless pursuit of her goals, unexpectedly saves Hilda from the flames and disappears amidst the chaos.

The confrontation in the Oldtown concludes, bringing the curtain down on the cursed letter incident. As they return, team members send heartfelt letters, each a warm glow lighting their inner thoughts...
Introduced by Sage, three young women approached Baker's Cafe seeking your assistance. From them, you learned about a mysterious drug known as "Code N."
To aid in your investigation, you headed to a clothing store on Castaway Island to pick out suitable disguises but were met with a series of unexpected events.
You and Garfire infiltrated Maria Harbor to gather intel, but progress was frustratingly slow.
With no leads in sight, you decided to take the initiative. Your target became a "lucky employee" who was working alone.
After much effort, you've finally infiltrated the enemy camp to gather evidence, only to be confronted by a mysterious figure.
The mysterious person began to grow suspicious of your intentions, leading to an unavoidable confrontation.
During the confrontation, you found yourself at a disadvantage. To escape the situation, Garfire made a bold decision.
When the initial plan fell apart due to an explosion on the cargo ship, Delilah quickly proposed a new strategy, reminding you that there's always a way forward.
The Elis Bar had an underground area located in the "Midnight Sun" district, where the absence of clocks made it difficult to distinguish between day and night.
You had a meeting with Delilah to discuss a critical plan. When you arrived at the room on time, you found her in a disheveled state...
Delilah briefed you on the upcoming banquet and the next phase of the plan—infiltrating the banquet to gather vital intelligence.
The security check at the banquet was unusually strict. During your discussion, an impolite guest made a mocking comment that disrupted the atmosphere.
As the banquet officially commenced, Fisher delivered a passionate speech. However, his true actions contrasted sharply with his words, evoking feelings of disgust.
Fisher arranged for a friend to probe you for information. You were curious to see how long he could withstand Delilah's sharp wit.
Fisher approached you directly, and Delilah skillfully engaged him with her fabricated identity, which seemed to intrigue him, though his demeanor remained cold.
A server called Fisher away, and when he returned, his demeanor had changed dramatically. He became overly eager, raising your unease. It seemed he had learned something during his absence.
Delilah then pulled you away to "elope" from the banquet, but on your way back to the Elis Bar, you ran into some Anomalies.
The intertwining schemes and emotions set the stage for a sleepless night ahead.
As the discussions with Fisher were about to commence, you and Lily confirmed your readiness and entered the Neptune Group to confront him.
Lily's unique performance on Castaway Island lightened the tense atmosphere of the talks, prompting you to quickly have her start the actual demonstration.
You began to probe Mr. Fisher for information. After several attempts, his attitude toward you shifted significantly.
Amidst the bustling atmosphere, you seized the moment to steer the conversation towards "Code N." Just as Fisher was about to divulge classified information, an unexpected event interrupted.
With the "Code N" incident now behind you, Shiro has gone to the Ivorus for routine maintenance, leaving Lily in charge of the cafe. Life seems to have returned to its peaceful rhythm.
Lily prepared a unique Pathos Cuisine and the customers who came to try it reacted in unexpected ways.
During your break, you pulled out your phone to play the recently updated game "City Cat," but Lily had a different suggestion that caught your attention.
It turns out that Shiro's idea was to let Lily manage the cafe and organize the Inspector's daily routine. After observing her for a day, Shiro decided to implement some of her changes.
After some time, you returned to the Elis Bar to discuss the aftermath of the "Code N" incident with the three catgirls.
Both Fisher and Wright died on the same day, leaving behind a mysterious force that still needs to be understood.

At the carnival grounds, the Inspector enjoyed the festive atmosphere created by the visitors' playful water splashes. However, during their patrol, they unexpectedly encountered two suspicious individuals...
The Inspector joined forces with two Felinians from Mannava—Tara and Fon—to delve into the mystery surrounding the suspicious characters at the "Splish-splash Revelry."
Together, they uncovered numerous intriguing clues in the marketplace that seemed to connect back to Oat in some way...
Clang, clang! Suddenly, the clanging of trash cans echoed through the marketplace as Anomalies emerged!
After dealing with the Anomalies, the trio finally confronted Oat, but his behavior was strangely off—was he even the real Oat...?
Unable to find Oat at the performance site, the trio became targets of Joseph. The Inspector decided it was best to split up to track down Oat.
Fon, relying on luck, managed to evade the bodyguards and planned to uncover Oat's secrets, while Oat's questionable promotion of traditional crafts had already upset many...
Oat's lively warm-up performance also served as a backdrop for the Anomalies' antics...
After the Anomaly incident, both Oat and Joseph insisted on continuing the event. Meanwhile, Fon had already uncovered the truth behind the water cannons...
Fon discovered that Oat planned to use the water cannons to disperse Pathos Particles throughout the marketplace. The Inspector decided to split up to avert the looming disaster.
The Inspector and Tara accessed Oat's rest area through the ventilation system, inadvertently overhearing a plan to activate the water cannons prematurely...
Oat attempted to quell the unrest caused by the two Affliction incidents, but was exposed by the Inspector. As the Anomalies concert was about to begin...
Oat's lively warm-up performance also served as a backdrop for the Anomalies' antics...
The Inspector trio successfully foiled the imposter Oat's scheme, forcing the counterfeit to reveal its true identity...
The fake Oat tried to create chaos and escape, but the Inspector trio managed to apprehend him. To their surprise, the mastermind turned out to be a Chubby Cat!
With the matter resolved, Oat returned to express gratitude to the Inspector. The "Splish-splash Revelry" continued joyfully as everyone welcomed the new year.
In a secluded corner, the story unfolds...
During the Cherry Blossom Festival, you encountered a mysterious "fallen girl," only to realize her companion was Claire, the journalist you had met earlier.
With Lulu injured and Zoe rushing her to the hospital, Claire invited you to accompany her on an interview.
Strangely, she had enlisted robots as her bodyguards, leaving you curious about her reasons.
You managed to arrange an interview with Amos, the event's organizer. Beneath the gentle rain of petals, he shared fragments of a long-lost love story.
Amos expertly dodged your questions, but Claire—ever the tenacious reporter—sensed a scoop waiting to be uncovered.
It felt like Amos was trying to draw someone's attention with his strange revelations during the interview...
Now, even Claire's family, the Sabers, found themselves entangled in this complex web. Who was Amos truly targeting?
Every shared secret tips the scales between Zoe and Claire—but neither knows which side will crash down first.
Can Claire's relentless quest for the truth be halted? And is "protection" just another word for lies?
You struck a deal with Hilda, trading intel for safety... But does she really buy your act?
Two anxious hearts finally connect, as the silent walls between them crumble into dust, leaving only unfiltered honesty.
The revealed past glimmers sharply in the light, each fact a weighty stone in their hands.
You arrived at Amos's residence just in time to witness Hilda in the midst of an abduction—the confrontation was unavoidable.
His sense of self fractures like fault lines; everything he believed was an illusion—but without those beliefs, he is nothing...
Only the fallen cherry blossoms bore witness—silent spectators to an ending... and a beginning.
Though the blossoms may fade, this feeling endures. Pressed between ribs, it blooms forever.
After an unsuccessful search for Gordo at the Emotion Remedy Center, the Inspector stumbles upon a nurse secretly listening in on Jane's private talk...
As the group finishes their visit and leaves the Emotion Remedy Center, they are suddenly ambushed by Anomalies on their way back to the Stray Cat Shelter...
Returning to the Stray Cat Shelter, the Inspector is welcomed with warmth and familiarity. As the group settles in, stories of the shelter's recent events begin to unfold...
In the depths of night, the Inspector and Marie fend off a sudden Anomaly attack. When pressed for answers about the origin of the assault, Marie's silence speaks volumes...
Mira's scheme collapses—until Hildegard's call breaks the silence. With calculated precision, a new plan forms in Mira's mind...
A new day dawns at the Stray Cat Shelter. The resident cats weave between legs, their playful greetings signaling the usual chaos of a cozy, familiar morning...
Jane is taken. Marie, Anna, and the Inspector track the kidnappers' location, determined to rescue her. But it becomes clear that Marie is the real target...
In a high-speed pursuit, the Inspector's team corners the kidnappers—only for Anomalies to attack at the worst moment...
The Anomalies are gone, and so are the clues—just Jane's phone remains. But the real trouble is just beginning elsewhere...
Mira sets a trap, using hostages to draw Marie in. Little does she know, her captive overhears every word of the scheme...

Jane becomes the decoy, a distraction meant to pull the group apart. While their attention is divided, Raphaella vanishes. As the others scramble to devise a rescue plan, Marie slips away unnoticed...
Marie walks straight into danger alone—until Anna and the Inspector catch up to her, yet she won't let them follow...
Marie acts as the distraction, keeping Mira occupied while the Inspector and Anna execute their rescue plan. With Exe providing tactical support from afar, the operation springs into action...
The battle reaches a stalemate until Danica makes her explosive entrance, sending Mira flying from the platform. Cornered and desperate, Mira reveals her last, most perilous gambit...
An unexpected figure emerges in the factory—Hildegard. When the dust settles, she departs as mysteriously as she arrived. The nightmare at the Stray Cat Shelter finally comes to an end.
Morning sunlight and the aroma of breakfast fill the air as Marie finally lets go of her past. Surrounded by her family, the camera shutter captures their radiant faces—a moment frozen in time.

At the remote camp, Hildegard and the Captain debate Mira's fate with deceptively calm words that mask their sharp intentions. As their ship disappears over the horizon, darker clouds gather. This isn't the end—just the opening move in a much larger game.
A haunting melody guides them to Beatrice, the festival organizer. After lending her a hand, you earn invites to her event.
Market vendors share how hard Beatrice worked for the festival, giving you aromatic wishing tags.
Seagulls disrupt dinner until Trixie appears, driving them away and joining the team.
At night, you hang inscribed wishing tags on the Wishing Tree, dreaming of the festival ahead.
Sleepless after nightmares, you meet Beatrice on the beach. Her comforting words conceal a deep, unspoken sorrow...
As the festival kicks off, a sudden storm threatens to derail the festivities. Yet, against all odds, the celebration begins right on time.
With glowing delicacies and effortlessly fun games, every detail of the festival feels almost too good to be real.
Beneath its branches, you solemnly hang your wishing tags. When fireworks light up the sky, the festival reaches its breathtaking peak.
You awaken from blissful dreams in shock and find yourselves back at the festival's opening moment. Each repeated word and action confirms you're trapped in an endless summer night.
The festival reveals its darker side as visitors fall into dreamlike trances. When you attempt to awaken them, you are confronted by guards...
The Wishing Tree morphs into a monstrous theater that engulfs the tourists. Qi appears, unveiling the truth: this is a mindscape woven from both joy and sorrow.
Mandy, chasing her father's silhouette, recklessly charges into the theater, pulling you into her most buried memories...
You attend Mandy's family dinner, where her father surprisingly proves to be quite amiable. However, this warm moment shatters at the slightest disruption...
As the fantasy collapses, Mandy grapples with her father's departure once more. With your encouragement, she finds the strength to move forward.
The team comes together again. Under Qi's guidance, you navigate through complex stages, making your way toward the heart of the dreamscape.
Before the corrupted Wishing Tree, you face off against Beatrice. Your clash of ideals—whether to cling to fantasy or embrace reality—erupts into open conflict.
After the battle, you delve deep into Beatrice's past, reliving the fateful Summer Festival that changed her life forever.
Gloomtide engulfs all light—and everything Beatrice cherishes. In her darkest moment, a mysterious masked figure emerges...
Beatrice stands shattered. Mandy, sharing similar scars, reaches out in understanding. On the white stage, a long-overdue performance begins...
As the dreamscape dissipates, Trixie offers Beatrice an unexpected invitation. Summer fireworks illuminate the night sky—and lonely souls finally discover their place.
When you arrive in Farlant, Daphne puts you up in the most luxurious hotel. But waiting in your room is...
The Affliction ends without major incident. Daphne doesn't want to drag you into it, but you have your own plans.
Shiro walks you through the history of Farlant and Bauss.
A distinguished guest arrives in person, and a dangerous enemy ambushes you along the way... nothing goes as expected.
A girl brings word from a distant castle, throwing an already tangled situation into even deeper uncertainty.
Every clue points to Syrinos. Just as things start falling into place, Daphne suddenly suggests...
As an old Yaozhou saying goes: get ambushed once, and it'll never happen again...
Idego joins the group with a crucial lead. It's time to go on the offensive.
Smoke blots out the sky. In the endless dark, a girl with nowhere left to turn glimpses a single ray of light.
"Let's break a few stereotypes about Farlant's elite."
The girl recounts her past with Ulthar. Before your next move, you decide to throw her a party.
An unforgettable night, and a past that refuses to be forgotten…
On the day of the rehearsal, uninvited guests arrive right on schedule.
The battle plan is set, but Ulthar seems to be holding something back…
"I have to run—as far as I can—before the past catches up to me!"
The final operation begins. Under cover of darkness, you slip into Erdburg and encounter far less resistance than expected…
That eerie calm was the warning sign of a coming storm. Now there's no way out...
The source of all this ugliness and evil has finally revealed itself. It's time to put an end to it, once and for all.
The Amalgam's overwhelming regenerative power pushes you to the brink. Just when all seems lost, a glimmer of hope appears…
The worst ending a story can have is this: someone sets themselves ablaze to light the way for others, yet never lives to see the dawn… Is that really all it is?
The rot at the heart of Erdburg has finally been cleansed. This is an ending, but also a beginning.
Seeds buried deep beneath the earth finally find the light, blooming into flowers that drift up toward the sky.
You go to Akanuma Ren to ask about the accident at Niihara Station. Ren answers with a ghost story—a hint that you will have to find the truth on your own...
Dahlia recounts the history of Catto Transit, hoping you will uncover the truth and seek justice for the workers who died in the accident...
While riding the H Loop Line, you spot a drunk harassing a Felinian student. You step in to stop him—and notice signs of Affliction…
With the drunk subdued, the conductor leads you to the rear car. You reassure Ayaka—but a creeping sense of wrongness sets in...
The train hurtles through the tunnel without ever stopping. One by one, the things happening around you begin to echo the ghost story Ren told...
Heading toward the front of the train, you two step into Car 7—only to find yourselves caught in a loop. You realize the train runs by rules of its own...
Still puzzled, you feel your phone buzz—a message from an anonymous chatroom. With help from an "internet stranger," you figure out how the loop works...
You and Ayaka make your way to Car 3—but this time, the rules no longer seem to apply. Fear finally gets the better of Ayaka, and she looks back...
You two barely make it into Car 2. There, an old flip phone lies waiting, its screen lit with an incoming call—Hina Shinonome. The ghost girl from the story...
Ayaka finally recounts her past with Hina Shinonome. As her story draws to a close, the train pulls into the legendary "ghost station"—Last Cross...
On the platform, phantoms appear out of nowhere. You recognize them as Anomalies formed from Pathos Particles...
The phantoms fade, leaving behind a construction contract. Meanwhile, the mysterious user in the chatroom finally reveals their name...
You two reach another platform. Rumors and slander about Hina scroll across the screen. The files she left behind spill out of a locker...
The platform begins to collapse, and you two flee to the next. Unable to hold back the truth any longer, Ayaka reveals what she's really after: using you to save Hina…
You talk Ayaka into lowering her weapon. Through tears, she opens up about her past with Hina and resolves to "atone" in her own way…
"Hina Shinonome" steps out of the dark, trying to coax Ayaka into leaving you behind at Last Cross. Ayaka refuses, and the thing wearing Hina's face sheds its disguise...
You channel the Lightveil power to purify the Pathos Particles, but it soon wears you down. Before long, you two are backed into a corner...
Just as your vision begins to blur, the flip phone rings again. You find yourselves at a station out on the open sea—and there, at last, Ayaka is reunited with Hina...
You return to the train. This time, you are done being manipulated by Iris. You resolve to put an end to her twisted game once and for all...
Malice Incarnate is defeated, and you return to the real world. The truth comes to light, the balance of power shifts, and Ayaka returns to her normal life...

A pure white flower blooms in the dream world, and only the bravest can claim it.

You could mind-control trapped Felinians, and you found Sage, who was also trapped. Sage rescued a girl from a mysterious manor house, unleashing an eerie curse which then shrank her. To re-enter the manor house and find a way to break the curse, you had no choice but to touch the curse...

You heard the call for help from a girl who said her name was Aphros. The sudden appearance of Qi and the mysterious seigneur Minotara deepened your understanding of this operation. To lift the curse, you must help the girl called Aphros. After the two left, a bespectacled strange bird came at you...

To undo the curse and awaken Aphros, you had no choice but to go deeper. In the scattered memory fragments, you saw how Aphros had been abandoned at the front gate of the manor. However, the remaining Pathos Particles told you that there was more to the story. The manor gate blocked your path, and the peculiar bird caught up with you again.

After shaking off Abu, you found a new memory fragment. It showed that Aphros attempted to leave the manor, but Abu and Buck the hound joined hands, intercepted her, and dragged her back into the manor. However, the Pathos Particles on the gate displayed an entirely different memory, and this time the gate opened.

The memory fragment at the gate showed a gory scene. Buck caught Aphros and killed the mice that tried to save her. You returned to the manor only to encounter an army of mice and the hound wearing a paint bucket...

The white horse, Naphely, told you her master was Aphros, that Abu and Buck used to be her good friends, but a sudden fire had changed everything, and it had been on the same day that the manor was destroyed and the curse invaded...

You arrived at the kitchen only to discover that it had been reduced to the nest of rats. You attempted to quietly leave but Buck spotted you. The commotion drew the mice to the scene, along with Abu the mynah who had been persistently tracking you.

You told Buck about his agreement with his old friend Naphely in an effort to help him regain his sanity. Buck's memory had been tampered with, and he saw the mice who killed him as his saviors, forgetting all about his erstwhile companions. The mice caught up with you again. Under the command of the Wererat, Buck seemed to lapse into hysteria again...

You met Mother Capybara in person, who had appeared in Aphros's memory, and received help from her. The persistent Wererat appeared and bit Mother Capybara. Controlled by contamination, Mother Capybara came at you...

With Mother Capybara's help, you crossed the swamp, and you saw a giant oak tree growing between reality and the dreamworld. Mother Capybara requested you to save the oak that was about to be contaminated. After you bade her farewell, the surviving mice launched their final attack.
A fountain made of candies kept tempting you to taste the delicious candies. Abu the mynah hovered in the sky, poised to attack. At the crucial juncture, you found a way to resist the temptation…

You saw the undistorted version of Aphros's memory. Her handsome cousin Arsonas harbored evil intentions, and her adoptive mother Pollyanna was worried. In the evening, the castle was set on fire. Abu woke Aphros, but he himself went back to look for his Master Pollyanna. Maybe Abu knew what happened that night...

In the memory, Aphros who was awakening nailed Arsonas's lies, and Abu finally regained his sanity momentarily and told you what happened that night. The pain of the recollection caused Abu to suffer another mental breakdown and the contamination took control of him again.

Abu, having regained his sanity, fought against the contamination trying to manipulate him and offered you some crucial information. When you reached the greenhouse, Aphros was ready to leave with you, but you were observant enough to realize that this Aphros was an impostor, and you nailed the magic mirror's lies.

Having narrowly escaped death, you and Sage returned to the cavern. Minotara the seigneur answered your questions as promised. With Qi's help, you woke Aphros with a kiss, and she offered to give you the most precious thank-you gift...

Once again cursed to shrink in size, you find yourself surrounded by a world that feels overwhelmingly vast and disorienting. The familiar landscapes have transformed dramatically; what used to be a small mushroom now towers like a giant tree, obstructing your view. A stroll that once felt effortless has morphed into an arduous journey, especially with the threat of aerial predators lurking above.

Massive shrubs, twisted vines, and an unending labyrinth of iron gates create an atmosphere reminiscent of a never-ending nightmare. Fail to discern the proper path to escape, and you'll be condemned to wander in perpetual circles...

Imagine everyday foods—fresh produce, fruits, strings of cured meats, sausages, and dried fish—now transformed into colossal sizes, sprawling across an endless kitchen counter. Will you feel a thrill of excitement or a sense of dread?

A girl's dream is incomplete without charming dolls, enchanting fountains, and lush green grass. The scene that unfolds is an amplified version of a delightful fantasy—or has it perhaps morphed into a nightmare?

Wild weeds and scattered wildflowers grace the secluded niches of the flower-adorned walls. Perhaps, in this strange realm, you might just stumble upon the teapot that the manor's owner lost many years ago...

December is here, bringing with it the much-anticipated Snow Festival! The Snow Music Gala, hosted by superstar idols Triss and Erina, is about to make its dazzling debut. But danger lurks just off-stage...
You head out with Shiro to pick up some frosty decorations for the festival. Caught up in the holiday cheer, you run into Erina, who says she's "on the trail of a criminal."

Erina informs you that the Snow Festival stage has been vandalized by unknown assailants and a mysterious beast. The suspect is the very target she's chasing. With Anja and Mia by your side, the investigation begins!

The suspect has vanished into the Ice Sculpture Competition! As the probe stalls, a twist emerges, forcing the suspect out of hiding. It's Sherry, a Felinian girl, with a troupe of wild beasts by her side.

Suddenly, the mastermind whisked Sherry away. With the lead lost, your team opts to guard her animal friends before resuming the hunt. Yet, the restless creatures seem to catch her scent on the breeze.
Guided by the animals, you reach the Fireworks Show's viewing platform. There, you spot significant drag marks near a vent. What secrets lie at the duct's end?
In the fireworks depot, you confront the puppeteer, Serpent's Tongue, orchestrating Sherry's moves. His schemes disable your Pathos Armament, leaving you exposed. Amidst the turmoil, Mia vanishes...
As the enemy prepares for an all-out attack, Mia finds an escape route and joins your allies outside, disrupting Serpent's Tongue's plan. Though you escape danger, Sherry falls deeper into despair…
Sherry unveils her backstory—a life reliant on animals, marred by human treachery... Touched by your compassion, she casts off the chains of her past. Even Erina is visibly moved by Sherry's tale.

Through concerted efforts, you restore the Snow Music Gala venue just before showtime. As the performance begins, Erina, witnessed by the first snow, casts off her burdens and strides toward a brighter future.
After the Snow Music Gala concludes, you gather at the platform to enjoy the winter Fireworks Show. As the pyrotechnics light the sky, hidden currents stir beneath Catto City's façade.
